messages:
Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — Private Deployments v1 is launching today for customers on the enterprise track. Rolling availability starts at 16:00 UTC.
Alex Chen: awesome — is there an internal onboarding checklist we should point customers to?
Priya Nair: yes, short checklist below. Posting here so account teams and SRE know the flow.
Priya Nair: 1) Confirm network prerequisites (VPC peering, firewall rules)
Priya Nair: 2) KMS/HSM key exchange + customer acceptance test (CAT) window
Priya Nair: 3) Audit log sink config + retention policy
Priya Nair: 4) Onboarding runbook + cutover time window
Priya Nair: 5) SLA/Support tier confirmed in contract
Alex Chen: Ops notes for eng: ensure image v1.0 tags are ready, rollback tag is `release/v1.0-rollback`
Alex Chen: We'll use canary=10% -> full after 30m if metrics stable
Daniel Ruiz: Security items: verify TLS mutual auth, KMS key policy, and disable metadata service where required.
Daniel Ruiz: Also need a compliance statement for customers re: audit log immutability — Maya can you coordinate?
Maya Patel: Yep, I’ll draft a short email + attach SOC/ISO summary. Targeting customers earmarked this week.
ops-bot: deploy: scheduled private-deployments/v1.0 to eu-west-1 at 16:00 UTC — initiated by @Alex Chen
Alex Chen: Starting canary now (16:00). Health checks: 200 on /health and tail logs for errors.
Alex Chen: command: ```kubectl rollout status deployment/redwood-private --namespace=private-prod```
Alex Chen: logs: ```stern redwood-private -n private-prod --since 5m```
Priya Nair: Can customer success start booking kickoff slots? Suggested 1-hour windows.
Maya Patel: Booking now — first batch of 3 customers in our queue confirmed for tomorrow.
Daniel Ruiz: For audit: ensure `log_signer` has completed signature key rotation before we onboard external customers.
Alex Chen: Confirmed, rotation done at 15:20 UTC.
Priya Nair: Post-launch priorities: 1) verify latency SLOs for private tenants 2) confirm billing records for reserved capacity 3) monitor quality regressions (eval hooks)
Maya Patel: Creating a customer-facing short guide (1 page) with network snippets and expected prep time.
Daniel Ruiz: Note: customers requiring on-prem package will need air-gap support checklist — that’s a separate flow.
Priya Nair: Action owners: Alex = deploy + canary, Daniel = security checklist signoff, Maya = customer comms & scheduling.
Alex Chen: Canary healthy at +15m, no errors, 95th p99 latency within target. Increasing to 50% now.
ops-bot: alert: metric anomaly detected for routing-proxy in eu-west-1 at 16:21 UTC — spike in 5xxs (investigating)
Alex Chen: seeing the spike, rolling back the proxy config from `proxy-config/opt-2026-03-11` -> reverting.
Alex Chen: rollback complete, 5xxs dropping. Will re-run tests in a staging slice.
Priya Nair: Good catch. Hold canary expansion until proxy config validated in staging.
Maya Patel: Notifying affected customers of a short delay, will update once green.
Daniel Ruiz: Postmortem note: document proxy change and add a quick validation step in runbook before canary increase.
Priya Nair: Thanks team. I’ll post the final onboarding doc and link to the runbook here once updated.
Priya Nair: TL;DR for the org: Private Deployments v1 live in limited release, onboarding begins tomorrow, security & oncall caught a proxy issue during canary that was rolled back. No customer impact so far.
Maya Patel: +1 will follow up with the contracted customers tomorrow morning.
Alex Chen: Leaving the thread open for any follow-ups.
ops-bot: deploy: private-deployments/v1.0 rollout paused at 16:30 UTC by @Priya Nair (canary hold)
Priya Nair: Final note — owners, please update the checklist in Confluence: /spaces/PRIVATE/pages/Onboarding-Checklist and tag me when done. Thanks!
